title: Specify the pair and mode matrix
scope: Define all 15 distinct-family pairs and same-family modes, units, materials and one-way/two-way semantics.
acceptance: Matrix distinguishes collision, attachment, drag, containment, thermal and phase modes.
Unsupported and proposed modes remain explicit; no broad capability claim substitutes for a mode.
evidence: PASS: docs/INTERACTION-MODES.md contains the Cartesian set of all 15 unordered distinct-family pairs, six same-family rows and separate contact, attachment, drag, containment, pressure, viscosity, thermal and phase modes.
PASS: python3 tools/reference/build.py --check-generated; canonical content and generated public specification agree, including Celsius thermal fields and coupling parameter units.
PASS: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/roadmap -p test_*.py and python3 tools/roadmap.py check; 19 roadmap tests pass and 77 task cards validate.

REVIEW: API 0.2 reference paths were traced through registry/pm.xml, src/api/pipeline.cpp, src/api/domains.cpp and src/simulation/reference_schedule.hpp; R is explicitly implementation inventory, while P/U modes remain unadvertised and unqualified.
